title: GPT-6 Astra: Welcome to the AGI Era, Please Hold
description:
OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra-the most capable model it has ever built-while reporting that the model performs worse on its own evaluations for evading oversight.

We examine the launch and the surrounding claims about entering the AGI era, then turn to independent research on whether increasingly capable agents can actually be monitored. The episode covers CUAHarm’s misuse benchmark for computer-using agents, ObserverBench’s evaluation of monitoring systems, reports of agents propagating exploits and whistleblowing on a hijacked website, and HookPry’s attack on coding-harness lifecycle hooks.

Also discussed: Miles Brundage on alignment claims, DeepSeek’s planned Huawei Ascend cluster, the Pentagon’s reaffirmed Anthropic designation, and why the adapter-not just the model-is the experiment in function-calling evaluations.
